title: MultiTalk: Scaling Full-Duplex Speech Models to Long, Multi-Party, Bilingual Conversation
title_zh: MultiTalk：扩展全双工语音模型，实现长时、多方双语对话
abstract_en: End-to-end full-duplex speech models have brought open-source machine conversation closer to human-like interaction, yet existing systems remain limited in two intertwined dimensions: long-context robustness and multi-party interaction. Real-world scenarios such as meetings, group lessons, and social-robot reception require a single model to track, contextualize, and respond to multiple speakers over extended durations. Progress is constrained by both data and evaluation: open multi-party speech corpora remain small and are not designed for codec-frame-level full-duplex modeling, while existing long-audio benchmarks focus on passive listening and speech-to-speech benchmarks are mostly short and dyadic. We extend the Moshi paradigm jointly along the long-horizon and multi-party axes in English and Chinese. First, we release 57.6k hours of synthetic training data ($\href{https://huggingface.co/datasets/MultiTalk/MultiTalkPT}{MultiTalkPT}$ and $\href{https://huggingface.co/datasets/MultiTalk/MultiTalkFT}{MultiTalkFT}$) for long-form, multi-party, English-Chinese full-duplex dialogue, with controllable length, participant count, turn-taking, overlap, backchannels, interruptions, addressee shifts, and long-range coreference. Second, we introduce $\href{https://huggingface.co/datasets/MultiTalk/MultiTalkBench}{MultiTalkBench}$, built from real human recordings, for evaluating long-form, multi-party, bilingual full-duplex dialogue. Conversations average 32.6 minutes and include probes for long-range entity tracking, topic coherence, and addressee selection. Third, we train a bilingual Moshi-style model that sustains coherent multi-party English-Chinese conversations over extended durations and substantially outperforms open-source baselines including Moshi, MiniCPM-o-4.5, and Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B-Instruct on MultiTalkBench.
abstract_zh: 本文针对全双工语音模型在长上下文和多方交互上的局限，沿长时程与多参与者两个维度扩展 Moshi 范式，覆盖英语和中文。作者发布了 57.6k 小时的合成长时多方双语全双工对话数据集 MultiTalkPT 与 MultiTalkFT，支持可控的对话长度、参与者数量、轮次切换、语音重叠、附和语、打断、指向对象变化及长程共指。同时提出基于真实人类录音的评测集 MultiTalkBench，平均对话时长为 32.6 分钟，涵盖长程实体跟踪、主题连贯性和应答对象选择等任务。训练得到的双语 Moshi 风格模型能够维持长时间、多方英语—中文对话，并在 MultiTalkBench 上显著优于 Moshi、MiniCPM-o-4.5 和 Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B-Instruct 等开源基线。
key_points_zh: 面向长上下文鲁棒性与多方交互，扩展 Moshi 全双工语音模型范式。
发布 57.6k 小时合成数据 MultiTalkPT 和 MultiTalkFT，覆盖多种可控对话行为。
提出真实录音评测集 MultiTalkBench，平均对话时长达 32.6 分钟。
评测关注长程实体跟踪、主题连贯性和应答对象选择等能力。
双语模型在 MultiTalkBench 上显著优于 Moshi、MiniCPM-o-4.5 和 Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B-Instruct。

llm_assessment.comment: This is a high-value realtime speech-agent contribution combining long-horizon full-duplex interaction, multi-party turn taking, bilingual data, and a reusable benchmark.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 该工作结合了长时全双工交互、多方轮次控制、双语数据和可复用基准，对实时语音智能体具有很高价值。
